# Local H3 Studio — home ComfyUI + RunPod knowledge base

> Measured recipes and pitfalls for driving ComfyUI (Krea 2, Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, Krea 2 Identity Edit V2, MiniMax H3, LTX-2.5) headless on a 16 GB consumer GPU, training a persona LoRA with ai-toolkit on RunPod, and evaluating results. Written for agents. Version 2026-10-25.

## Agent docs
- [agent-guide.md](agent-guide.md): full guide — API driving, exact model files and settings, prompt templates, persona pipeline, LoRA config, evaluation metrics, RunPod procedure, Windows pitfalls.
- [ch-agent.html](ch-agent.html): same content inside the textbook page.

## Human chapters (Russian)
- [index.html](index.html): table of contents of the textbook.
